title: LocalIdentifier
description: Identifier from a national registry. Passed through unchanged for verification in local registries.

@type.description: Must be or contain `erdif:LocalIdentifier`, usually next to a schema.org type.

registryCountry.description: Country of the registry per ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

registryLevel.description: Level of the identified object within the registry (e.g. `Address`, `Building`, `Parcel`).

identifier.description: Identifier of the object in the registry.
